versions.changelog:
Initial release of GPT Image 2 — Pro Pack on RunComfy.

- Enables image generation and editing using OpenAI’s GPT Image 2 model via RunComfy CLI.
- Supports explicit embedded text, logos, signage, multilingual typography, and high-fidelity layouts.
- Offers text-to-image and image-edit endpoints (with up to 10 reference images for edits).
- Requires only a RunComfy account and CLI—no OpenAI API key needed.
- Includes clear documentation on invocation, input schema, and best practices for prompting and iteration.
